decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting builds directly on the firm's specialist knowledge of robust, standards-compliant lighting, so the firm can interpret results from naval customers and keep refining the line.

The spring-balanced desk lamp uses the firm's ergonomic office lighting know-how but sits outside its project-based core, so the risk of dropping it stays moderate even though it has a dedicated page.
As a second-generation iteration of an established interior luminaire, it builds on the firm's existing LED and testing capabilities, which makes it well absorbed and low risk.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship grounded in the firm's own optics research and its push toward glare-free, efficient lighting, so management will keep investing in it.
Marine know-how supports the HMI searchlight, but HMI technology runs against the firm's LED direction, so a phase-out remains a real possibility.
The marine searchlight line fits the firm's established marine and robust-lighting competence, which lets it maintain and update the product effectively.
